_: Migrations an older release can run on top of: they only add tables or settings the older code never reads, and they can run again (IF NOT EXISTS, guarded updates). Going back to a release without them sets them aside (scripts/set-aside-migrations.mjs) instead of needing a database restore; going forward runs them again. Never list one that adds a column (SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS) or changes existing data.
